name: Restaurant & Cafe
summary: One-page site for a place that serves food: full-bleed hero photo with a slow Ken Burns drift and the business name set huge over it, Call to reserve + Text an order buttons, a notched 'Today' ticket overlapping the hero (hours with today's line highlighted, address, parking note), a tabbed menu with dotted price leaders, a story with an offset photo, spinning seal and pull line, a masonry gallery with a lightbox and a call tile, a reserve/visit block, and an inverted footer with a giant wordmark. Warm, appetising, editorial.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Full-bleed photo (slow Ken Burns), eyebrow with the city, h1 = {{business}} in huge type, lead = {{tagline}}, Call to reserve (tel:) + Text an order (sms:) buttons
sections.edit: Keep the h1 as the business name (names over about 22 characters get a smaller size automatically). Rewrite <title> as "Business | kind of place in City" (10-60 characters) and the meta description (50-160). Rename the buttons to fit (for example 'Call to order' for a food truck or bakery); keep the tel: and data-sms links. The eyebrow can name the kind of place, for example 'Bakery and coffee in {{city}}'

sections.name: today
sections.what: Notched ticket overlapping the hero: today's weekday (app.js), opening hours with today's line marked, address with a Directions link, and a parking/transit note
sections.edit: Write one true line about parking, transit or step-free access, or delete that <div class="today__col"> (the other two columns stretch). Hours come from {{hours}}

sections.name: menu
sections.what: Centered head, accessible tabs (one per menu panel; arrow keys work; without JavaScript every panel shows), dishes with name (h4), dotted leader, price and one-line description, an allergy note
sections.edit: One panel per real menu section, with a matching tab button (same id/aria-controls pairs). One <li class="dish"> per real dish; replace every 'Price' with the owner's real price or delete the <span class="dish__price"> and its dots. Never invent dishes or prices: if the owner gave no menu, delete the whole section

sections.name: story
sections.what: Offset photo with an outline frame and a spinning {{initial}} seal; eyebrow, h2, two short paragraphs, a large pull line and a signature line
sections.edit: Write the owner's real story in 2-3 short sentences per paragraph. The pull line is one line in the owner's own words, never an invented customer quote. Delete the section if there is no story to tell

sections.name: gallery
sections.what: Masonry (CSS columns): 4 photos (tall, wide, wide, tall so the seams stagger) that open in a lightbox with alt text captions, plus a 'Hungry yet?' call tile
sections.edit: Use the owner's real photos of food, drinks and the room; write honest alt text, it becomes the caption. Delete the section if there are no real photos

sections.name: visit
sections.what: Reserve and visit: h2, lead, three big action rows (Call to reserve, Text an order, Get directions) and a card with hours, address, phone and email
sections.edit: Rename the action rows to match how the place works (reservations, pickup, delivery). Delete the email row if there is no email

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Inverted colours (ink background), giant wordmark, address, phone, email, copyright, back to top
sections.edit: Tokens only; add a real social link only if the owner gave one

photo_slots.hint: an appetising wide shot: a plated dish on a table, the dining room, the counter or the storefront; it is darkened at the bottom and left for the text, so busy detail there is fine
the owner, the kitchen at work, the counter, or bread/coffee being made
drinks, a table spread or the terrace (shown 4:3)
another dish, a dessert or a pastry (shown 4:5)

behaviors: header sits transparent on the photo, then turns solid and shrinks on scroll
slow Ken Burns drift on the hero photo (off for reduced motion and screenshots)
Today ticket shows the weekday and highlights today's opening hours line (app.js parses {{hours}})
menu tabs with a sliding underline, arrow/Home/End keys, dishes stagger in on switch; all panels show without JavaScript
masonry gallery with a lightbox (arrows, swipe, Esc, focus returns)
sms: and Google Maps links are built in app.js from {{phone_href}} and the data-address attribute
floating Call button on phones once the hero has scrolled away
reveal on scroll, scroll progress bar, slow spinning seal, gentle parallax on the story photo
style_notes: Works with every style; strongest with warm-hospitality, editorial-serif, dark-luxury, earthy-craft, retro-americana, poster-bold and coastal. Tested at 390 and 1280 with warm-hospitality, dark-luxury, poster-bold, soft-pastel, neo-brutalist, midnight-neon, editorial-serif and high-contrast-sport. Hero text is white on a darkened photo (a gradient scrim sits under it); everything else only uses --c-ink/--c-muted on --c-bg/--c-surface and --c-on-accent on --c-accent. The footer inverts ink and bg. Prices are the word 'Price' until the owner gives real ones.
